title: Mummy Sorcerer Awakening
description: A central mummified child-like figure with glowing green hands and purple magical energy stands on a stone pedestal, partially unwrapped with visible hieroglyph-covered wrappings and skin. Smaller mummified figures emerge from purple smoke at its feet against a background of cracked ancient stone walls with hieroglyphs and dramatic light rays from above.
prompt: A terrifying mummified child sorcerer stands powerfully on a cracked stone pedestal, its body wrapped in aged beige bandages covered in glowing circular hieroglyphs, with loose wrappings trailing in the air. The figure has pale textured skin, an intense expression, and glowing green energy emanating from its hands as it casts purple magical flames and smoke. Smaller mummified figures claw upwards from the purple mist at its feet. The background consists of ancient cracked stone walls filled with Egyptian-style hieroglyphs, dramatic beams of light cutting through the dusty air from above, dark fantasy style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting
